reason: The two blind annotators disagreed on at least one feature for 2634 of 3000 items.

Feature-level kappa was adequate only for transformation_required (0.7366); composition, multi-step, external knowledge, answer mode, and directness were not sufficiently reliable for feature selection.
The frozen Gemma adjudicator passed a 48-item preflight but full adjudication repeatedly recompiled dynamic CUDAGraphs and was interrupted before any output artifact was written.
A third model's decisions would not repair low primary inter-annotator reliability.
consensus_rule: Use a feature value only when Annotator A and Annotator B exactly agree; otherwise set that feature to UNC. Do not use third-model adjudication.

feature_selection_reliability_gate.metric: Cohen's kappa between Annotator A and Annotator B
feature_selection_reliability_gate.effect: Features below the gate may be reported descriptively but cannot be selected as a Stage E feature candidate.
